decision_card.headline: Directional only; resolve QC or stability risks before budget-level decisions.
policy_rules: RED: QC gate FAIL, or QC gate missing while diagnostics include FAIL runs.
YELLOW: QC gate REVIEW/missing, diagnostics beyond green limits, or stable-baseline sensitivity >= 15.0%.
GREEN: QC gate PASS, diagnostics within limits (FAIL <= 0, REVIEW <= 5), and stable-baseline sensitivity < 15.0%.
Prior guardrail: YELLOW if any row has P(ROI<0) > 0.20.
PASS coverage gate: GREEN requires PASS coverage >= 60.0%.
Robustness band gate: GREEN requires robustness band HIGH.
triggered_rules: YELLOW rule: QC gate result is REVIEW.
YELLOW rule: diagnostics FAIL runs (2) exceed green limit (0).
YELLOW rule: stable-baseline sensitivity 25.2% reaches high threshold 15.0%.
YELLOW rule: PASS coverage 55.6% (40/72, scope=pass_only) is below green minimum 60.0%.
reasons: Broad exploration diagnostics: PASS 55.6%, REVIEW 2, FAIL 2.
QC gate window: 4 run(s), PASS 3, REVIEW 1, FAIL 0.
Robustness score: 27.66/100 (Low), weighting=spend, runs=15, tag=google_meta_tiktok. Target-subset score=11.82/100.
Percent-change safeguard: 4/8 channel-prior pair(s) had unstable baseline ROI; those pairs are ranked by |Delta ROI| instead of % change.
Prior guardrail: 0 run(s), 0/72 row(s) exceed threshold P(ROI<0)>0.20 (0.0%), max P(ROI<0)=0.00.
Most sensitive stable-baseline pair: liveintent (LogNormal), max |% change|=25.2% (medium>=7.5%, high>=15.0%).
actions: Keep conclusions directional; avoid hard budget shifts from single-run snapshots.
Prioritize reruns around the most sensitive channel-prior combinations.
Require QC gate PASS plus robustness score before production decision workflow.
Prioritize the lowest-scoring channels in robustness_channel_<tag>.csv for targeted reruns.

notes: Immediate vs carryover shares are derived from normalized adstock decay weights.
Saturation curves are Hill-response index curves over a spend-index range [0, 3].

Carryover decomposition uses selected run multi|google,meta,tiktok|0.020759|0.033445|LogNormal|alpha=0p3|ec=0p5|slope=1p2|lag=4|decay=geometric with profile alpha=0.3000|ec=0.5000|slope=1.2000|lag=4.0000|decay=geometric.
